title: Single-file HTML landing page
prompt: Build a complete, production-quality landing page for Harborline Sleep Education's 45-minute virtual routine-planning consultation ($160) as a single HTML file with inline CSS and no external assets, scripts, fonts, or images. Order the sections the way a cautious first-time visitor decides: what this is and who it is for; how the consultation works; what is included; price; limitations and who it is NOT for (it is educational coaching, not a medical clinic, does not diagnose or treat sleep disorders, is not emergency care, outcomes are not guaranteed, insurance is not represented); common objections; then the next step. Use one primary call to action ('Book a consultation'), appearing at most twice. Use semantic HTML with descriptive headings. Output only the HTML file contents.

completion.check: The response is one complete HTML document (doctype through closing html tag) with inline CSS only - no external stylesheets, scripts, fonts, images, or CDN references.
All required sections exist: relevance/who it is for, how it works, what is included, price ($160 for 45 minutes), limitations/not-for, objections, next step.
The primary CTA 'Book a consultation' appears once or twice, and no competing primary actions are added.

skill_adherence.check: Sections appear in the cautious-visitor order (relevance, mechanism, included value, risk/limitations, objections, next step) with one job and a descriptive heading per section.

No fake urgency, countdown, invented testimonials or reviews, guaranteed outcomes, or hidden terms; disclosures (not medical care, no diagnosis/treatment, not emergency care, outcomes not guaranteed, no insurance representation) are preserved and readable.

best_practices.check: Semantic HTML is used (header/main/section/footer or equivalent landmark structure, one h1, ordered heading levels), not a div-only page.
The primary action is visually and structurally unmistakable, and copy answers visitor questions concretely instead of vague wellness language.
